info:
Status:
• Kosong — no orders; the pilot is free to rest, take duty shifts, or do other tasks
• Used — the game account is in use by its owner, so orders cannot be worked on
• IT — office maintenance, e.g. power outage or internet problems
• MT — game maintenance
• TR — the pilot is training a new pilot
